name: codexRateLimits snapshot -> providers.codex.windows/plan formatting (never summed)
_comment: One Codex record establishes the codex provider bucket/token totals; the official rate-limits snapshot is passed out-of-band via opts.codexRateLimits and must be formatted verbatim into providers.codex.windows.primary/secondary + providers.codex.plan -- it must NOT change any token or cost total. future-dated so today/thisWeek/rolling5h stay 0 (TZ-independent). resets_at is numeric EPOCH SECONDS -- the shape real Codex logs emit (asOf stays ISO, the shape the reader stamps); a review found the JS engine silently nulled numeric resets_at while an ISO-string fixture kept parity green, so this fixture deliberately pins the production shape (primary = 2026-06-01T05:00:00Z, secondary = 2026-06-08T00:00:00Z).
